text: Refines D-0296 for #557: CI's Vet and unit tests step passes -timeout 20m, as the unit-test command does, so a package that's slow but finishes isn't failed at go test's default ten minutes. internal/plumbing's tests took 301 to 392 seconds there, and #546's eight new acceptance tests, which compile instrumented Go test binaries, took the package past ten minutes. The job's 30-minute limit stays. @gitdek had it built by hand, since the factory's one Codex turn was going to #549.
